0022600187.text: The Magic (2-4) are 5th in the Southeast and 9th in the East, with a 0-3 home record and a 2-1 road record, and they enter on a one-game losing streak. The Suns (1-3) are 12th in the West and have lost their last two games. Orlando will be without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Anthony Black (rest), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery) and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), while Phoenix will be without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Magic winning the most recent meeting 115-111 in Orlando on March 31, 2026.
